<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-04-0418-14-59" status="unreviewed">dang po la yang log rtogs dgod pa ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha 1</rs> na re phyogs chos kyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> rtags chos can la ngo bo dbyer med kyi ldog pa tha dad du rten par nges pa yin zer | de mi 'thad de de ltar na stong nyid la sgrub chos ma dor bas ma yin dag gi tha snyad sgrub pa 'di phyogs chos yang dag du 'gyur stong nyid la ngo bo dbyer med kyi ldog
               <lb n="51a7"/>pa tha dad du nges pa yod pa'i phyir | 'dod na sgrub chos ma dor ba la ma yin dagis khyab pa yang tshang bas yang dag pa'i rtags su 'gyur de yang 'dod na stong nyid ma yin dgag du <expan>thal lo</expan> |</seg></TEI>
